name: Puerto Armuelles, Panama

rent.notes: Expat reports from 2025 put a 2BR apartment at about $500 and a 3BR house at $400-800. A 2024 Live and Invest Overseas account says $500 or less. No source quoted a premium for a pet-friendly home with a 100 lb dog, so typical sits a little above the 2BR figure.

sources.title: Cost of Living in Puerto Armuelles - Expat Exchange
Settled in Sleepy Puerto Armuelles - Live and Invest Overseas

utilities.notes: Panama-wide figures from October 2026: electricity $50-200 depending on A/C, water and garbage $12-25, propane about $5 a tank. A hot coastal town with A/C sits in the middle to upper part of that range. A 2024 local account reported under $100 for all utilities.

sources.title: Cost of Living in Panama 2026 - ExpatDen
Settled in Sleepy Puerto Armuelles - Live and Invest Overseas

healthcare.notes: Private health insurance premiums for two adults age 60-61. Min is two Family Medical Plan memberships ($117.30 each, ages 60-69); typical and max reflect 2026 local quotes of $6,000-10,000/yr for a couple age 60. Premiums are national and age-rated. Pensionado discounts apply to services, not premiums.

sources.title: Panama Relocation Tours - Health insurance options in Panama
Feather - Health insurance in Panama guide (Jul 2026)

insurance.notes: Placeholder for renters/contents insurance. Panamanian insurers do not publish home premiums; an October 2026 guide only gives deductibles ($600 earthquake, $300 flood on $30k of contents).

petDaycare.notes: No dog daycare exists locally, so this is modeled as boarding at the national rate of $10-30 a night, 2-4 nights a month. The nights per month are an assumption, and boarding is likely only in David.

petGrooming.notes: Full grooming in Panama typically costs $20-40, modeled as about one session a month. A heavy Bernese coat puts typical near the top of that range, and a groomer may mean a trip to David.

transportation.notes: One car: insurance $500-900 a year ($42-75 a month), plus 91 octane at B/.1.173 per liter in Puerto Armuelles (June 2026) for about 40-100 L a month including David trips. Maintenance and taxis are an estimate (about $10-40). No car purchase cost is included.

entertainment.notes: Fixed internet is weak (a reader reported 7 Mbps for $99, and Tigo fiber was unavailable), so this uses Starlink at about $75 a month ($450 hardware not included). Also included: streaming at $7-50 and dining at about $15 per person for 2-4 dinners a month, plus activities.

phoneCell.notes: Tigo/Mas Movil standard postpaid is $27 per line (October 2026), so $54 for two lines. A separate guide puts mostly-local use at $10-50 per line. Claro pricing was not found.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

pros: Beachfront property still available at low cost
